about: Rune Bridges shots (runeBolt and its tinted kin): a cyan rune glyph of light.
name: Rune

bolt.png.prompt: Paint a small carved rune glyph made of glowing pale cyan-white light, sharp angular strokes, a soft cyan halo around it and a short trail of fading glyph dust to the left. Pure light, nothing solid. Plain flat pure black background (#000000), no floor, no scenery, centered with plenty of empty black space around it. Dark fantasy video game effect art, painterly, glowing.
